item.title: How to connect Node.js to MongoDB
item.description: Connecting Node.js to MongoDB enables persistent data storage for web applications using one of the most popular NoSQL database solutions. As the creator of CoreUI with extensive Node.js experience since 2014, I’ve connected Node.js applications to MongoDB in countless production systems for user data, content management, and analytics. The most reliable approach uses the official MongoDB driver with connection pooling and proper error handling. This method provides robust database connectivity while handling connection failures and maintaining optimal performance.
